principal-backend-go.description: Sample Co. is hiring a Principal Backend Engineer to own the design and reliability of our core platform. You will build high-throughput services in Go and Python on AWS (Lambda, SQS, DynamoDB), lead migrations with no downtime, raise the reliability of our CI/CD and data pipelines, lead projects across teams and mentor engineers. Hands-on experience building LLM tooling (MCP servers, RAG, evals) is a plus.
